name: Vegetable Dip
description: A creamy dip made with sour cream and mayonnaise, flavored with various seasonings and herbs, served with vegetables or crackers.
recipeIngredient: Assorted vegetables or crackers for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a dish.
Chill before serving with chips, crackers, or vegetables.

keywords: vegetable dip, sour cream dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Yogurt Dip
_similar.description: A refreshing yogurt-based dip flavored with mayonnaise, herbs, and seasonings, perfect for vegetables.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup sour cream or plain yogurt

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.
Let sit in the fridge for 1 hour to allow flavors to meld.
Serve with vegetables.

_similar.keywords: yogurt dip, healthy dip, vegetable dip

_similar.name: Surprise Spread
_similar.description: A layered seafood dip with shrimp, cocktail sauce, and cheese.
recipeIngredient: 3 (4 oz) cans small shrimp, rinsed and drained
Tortilla chips or assorted crackers for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, and mayonnaise together until smooth.
Spread this mixture in the bottom of a deep pie plate, pizza pan, or shallow baking dish.
Scatter the shrimp over the top.
Cover with the seafood cocktail sauce.
Add layers of mozzarella cheese, green pepper, and green onions.
Top with diced tomatoes if desired.
Chill until ready to serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

_similar.keywords: layered shrimp dip, seafood spread, party dip

_similar.name: Crab Dip
_similar.description: A rich and creamy crab dip made with cream cheese, crab meat, and green onions, served with crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Blend all ingredients together, including the juice from the crab meat, until smooth.
Serve with crackers.

_similar.keywords: crab dip, seafood dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Sticky Wings
_similar.description: Baked chicken wings glazed with a sweet and savory brown sugar and soy sauce mixture.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 300°F.
Break chicken wings apart at the joints and discard tips.
Place wings in a roasting pan and cover with the sauce mixture (brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic salt).
Bake until the sauce evaporates and wings are sticky.

_similar.keywords: sticky chicken wings, baked wings, appetizer

_similar.name: Cheese Ball
_similar.description: A classic cheese ball made with grated cheese, Cheez Whiz, and deviled ham, perfect for a quick appetizer.
recipeIngredient: Chopped pecans or parsley flakes for coating

recipeInstructions.text: Beat all ingredients in a mixer until creamed.
Form into 2 balls and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate until firm.
Roll into chopped pecans or parsley flakes to coat.

_similar.keywords: cheese ball, party appetizer, easy snack
